arabic: صَبَاحُ الخَيْرِ، كَيْفَ حَالُكَ اليَوْمَ؟
english: Good morning, how are you today?
acceptedAlternatives: Good morning, how're you today?
Good morning, how are you doing today?
Good morning, how do you do today?
literalMeaning: Morning of the good, how is your condition today?

arabic: هَلْ يُمْكِنُنِي الحُصُولُ عَلَى كُوبٍ مِنَ المَاءِ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ؟
english: Can I have a cup of water, please?
acceptedAlternatives: Could I have a cup of water, please?
May I have a glass of water, please?
Can I get a cup of water, please?
Can I get a glass of water, please?
literalMeaning: Is it possible for me obtaining on a cup of water, from your favor?

arabic: أَيْنَ تَقَعُ أَقْرَبُ مَحَطَّةِ قِطَارٍ مِنْ هُنَا؟
english: Where is the nearest train station from here?
acceptedAlternatives: Where's the nearest train station from here?
Where is the closest train station from here?
Where's the closest train station from here?
literalMeaning: Where falls nearest station of train from here?

arabic: أَنَا مُمْتَنٌّ جِدًّا لِمُسَاعَدَتِكَ اللَّطِيفَةِ.
english: I am very grateful for your kind help.
acceptedAlternatives: I'm very grateful for your kind help.
I am really grateful for your kind help.
I'm really grateful for your kind help.
literalMeaning: I am grateful very for your help the kind.

arabic: سَأَلْتَقِي بِأَصْدِقَائِي فِي المَقْهَى بَعْدَ انْتِهَاءِ العَمَلِ.
english: I will meet my friends at the cafe after work.
acceptedAlternatives: I'll meet my friends at the cafe after work.
I will meet my friends at the coffee shop after finishing work.
I'll meet my friends at the cafe after finishing work.
literalMeaning: I will meet with my friends in the cafe after end of the work.

arabic: يَبْدُو أَنَّ الطَّقْسَ سَيَكُونُ مَاطِرًا هَذَا المَسَاءَ.
english: It looks like the weather will be rainy this evening.
acceptedAlternatives: It seems that the weather will be rainy this evening.
It looks like it will rain this evening.
It seems like the weather will be rainy tonight.
literalMeaning: It appears that the weather will be rainy this evening.

arabic: لَا تَنْسَ شِرَاءَ بَعْضِ الخُضْرَاوَاتِ الطَّازَجَةِ فِي طَرِيقِ عَوْدَتِكَ.
english: Don't forget to buy some fresh vegetables on your way back.
acceptedAlternatives: Do not forget to buy some fresh vegetables on your way back.
Don't forget to get some fresh vegetables on your way home.
Do not forget to buy some fresh vegetables on your way home.
literalMeaning: Do not forget buying some of the vegetables fresh in path of your return.

arabic: أُفَضِّلُ القِرَاءَةَ فِي هُدُوءِ اللَّيْلِ عَلَى مُشَاهَدَةِ التِّلْفَازِ.
english: I prefer reading in the quiet of the night over watching television.
acceptedAlternatives: I prefer reading in the quiet of the night to watching TV.
I prefer reading in the quiet of night rather than watching television.
I prefer reading in the quiet of the night to watching television.
literalMeaning: I prefer the reading in quiet of the night over watching the television.

arabic: يَتَطَلَّبُ الحِفَاظُ عَلَى نَمَطِ حَيَاةٍ صِحِّيٍّ التِزَامًا يَوْمِيًّا بِالتَّغْذِيَةِ السَّلِيمَةِ وَالمُمَارَسَةِ الرِّيَاضِيَّةِ.
english: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle requires a daily commitment to proper nutrition and physical exercise.
acceptedAlternatives: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle requires daily commitment to proper nutrition and exercise.
Keeping a healthy lifestyle requires a daily commitment to balanced nutrition and physical exercise.
literalMeaning: Preserving on style of life healthy requires commitment daily to nutrition sound and practice sports.

arabic: تُسْهِمُ مُشَارَكَةُ الوَجَبَاتِ العَائِلِيَّةِ فِي تَعْزِيزِ الرَّوَابِطِ العَاطِفِيَّةِ بَيْنَ أَفْرَادِ الأُسْرَةِ.
english: Sharing family meals contributes to strengthening emotional bonds among family members.
acceptedAlternatives: Sharing family meals helps strengthen emotional bonds between family members.
Sharing family meals contributes to strengthening the emotional bonds between family members.
literalMeaning: Sharing family meals contributes in strengthening emotional bonds between members of the family.

arabic: عَلَى الرَّغْمِ مِنِ ازْدِحَامِ جَدْوَلِ مَوَاعِيدِهِ، فَإِنَّهُ يَحْرِصُ دَائِمًا عَلَى تَخْصِيصِ وَقْتٍ لِلِاسْتِرْخَاءِ.
english: Despite his busy schedule, he always makes sure to set aside time for relaxation.
acceptedAlternatives: Despite a busy schedule, he always ensures setting aside time for relaxation.
Although his schedule is crowded, he always makes sure to allocate time for relaxation.
In spite of his busy schedule, he always makes sure to set aside time to relax.
literalMeaning: Despite crowd of schedule of his appointments, indeed he is keen always on allocating time for relaxation.

arabic: هَلْ يُمْكِنُكَ إِعَارَتِي مِظَلَّتَكَ لِبِضْعِ دَقَائِقَ حَتَّى يَتَوَقَّفَ الهَطْلُ؟
english: Can you lend me your umbrella for a few minutes until the downpour stops?
acceptedAlternatives: Could you lend me your umbrella for a few minutes until the rain stops?
Can you lend me your umbrella for a few minutes until the rain stops?
literalMeaning: Is it possible for you lending me your umbrella for a few minutes until stops the downpour?

arabic: سَأَتَّصِلُ بِكَ عِنْدَمَا أَصِلُ إِلَى المَنْزِلِ.
english: I will call you when I arrive home.
acceptedAlternatives: I'll call you when I arrive home.
I will call you when I get home.
I'll call you when I get home.
I will phone you when I get home.
literalMeaning: I will contact with you when I reach to the house.

arabic: هَذَا التَّطْبِيقُ سَهْلُ الِاسْتِخْدَامِ وَيَعْمَلُ بِسُرْعَةٍ فَائِقَةٍ.
english: This application is easy to use and runs extremely fast.
acceptedAlternatives: This app is easy to use and works very fast.
This application is easy to use and works extremely fast.
This app is user-friendly and runs extremely fast.
literalMeaning: This application easy of use and works with speed superior.

arabic: يَجِبُ عَلَيْكَ تَحْدِيثُ كَلِمَةِ المُرُورِ بِانْتِظَامٍ لِحِمَايَةِ حِسَابِكَ.
english: You must update your password regularly to protect your account.
acceptedAlternatives: You should update your password regularly to protect your account.
You have to update your password regularly to protect your account.
You need to update your password regularly to protect your account.
literalMeaning: Must upon you updating word of pass with regularity to protect your account.

arabic: تَمَّ حِفْظُ التَّعْدِيلَاتِ فِي قَاعِدَةِ البَيَانَاتِ بِنَجَاحٍ.
english: The changes were saved to the database successfully.
acceptedAlternatives: The changes have been saved to the database successfully.
Modifications were saved to the database successfully.
The edits were saved in the database successfully.
literalMeaning: Completed saving the modifications in base of data with success.

arabic: تُسَاعِدُ حَوْسَبَةُ السَّحَابَةِ فِي تَقْلِيلِ تَكَالِيفِ البِنْيَةِ التَّحْتِيَّةِ لِلشَّرِكَاتِ النَّاشِئَةِ.
english: Cloud computing helps reduce infrastructure costs for startups.
acceptedAlternatives: Cloud computing helps to reduce infrastructure costs for startups.
Cloud computing assists in reducing infrastructure costs for startup companies.
literalMeaning: Helps computing of cloud in reducing costs of structure under for companies emerging.

arabic: تَحْتَاجُ الخَوَارِزْمِيَّةُ إِلَى تَحْسِينٍ لِتَقْلِيلِ اسْتِهْلَاكِ الذَّاكِرَةِ وَزَمَنِ التَّنْفِيذِ.
english: The algorithm needs optimization to reduce memory consumption and execution time.
acceptedAlternatives: The algorithm requires optimization to reduce memory consumption and execution time.
The algorithm needs optimization to lower memory usage and execution time.
literalMeaning: Needs the algorithm to improvement to reduce consumption of memory and time of execution.

arabic: قَامَ الفَرِيقُ بِإِصْلَاحِ الخَلَلِ البَرْمَجِيِّ الَّذِي تَسَبَّبَ فِي تَعَطُّلِ النِّظَامِ.
english: The team fixed the bug that caused the system crash.
acceptedAlternatives: The team resolved the software bug that caused the system crash.
The team fixed the software defect that caused the system breakdown.
The team repaired the bug that crashed the system.
literalMeaning: Did the team with repairing the defect programming which caused in disruption of system.

arabic: تَعْتَمِدُ نَمَاذِجُ التَّعَلُّمِ العَمِيقِ عَلَى شَبَكَاتٍ عَصَبِيَّةٍ مُعَقَّدَةٍ لِمُعَالَجَةِ الصُّوَرِ.
english: Deep learning models rely on complex neural networks to process images.
acceptedAlternatives: Deep learning models depend on complex neural networks for image processing.
Deep learning models rely on intricate neural networks to process images.
literalMeaning: Rely models of learning deep on networks neural complex to process the images.

arabic: يُعَدُّ التَّشْفِيرُ طَرَفًا لِطَرَفٍ مِعْيَارًا أَسَاسِيًّا لِحِمَايَةِ خُصُوصِيَّةِ المُسْتَخْدِمِينَ عَبْرَ الإِنْتَرْنِت.
english: End-to-end encryption is considered an essential standard for protecting user privacy on the internet.
acceptedAlternatives: End-to-end encryption is a fundamental standard for protecting user privacy online.
End-to-end encryption is considered a fundamental benchmark for securing user privacy over the internet.
literalMeaning: Is counted the encryption end to end standard fundamental to protect privacy of users across the internet.

arabic: تَتَطَلَّبُ المِعْمَارِيَّةُ القَائِمَةُ عَلَى الخَدَمَاتِ المُصَغَّرَةِ اسْتِرَاتِيجِيَّاتٍ قَوِيَّةً لِمُرَاقَبَةِ الأَدَاءِ وَإِدَارَةِ الأَخْطَاءِ.
english: Microservices architecture requires robust strategies for performance monitoring and error management.
acceptedAlternatives: A microservices architecture requires robust strategies for monitoring performance and error handling.
Microservices architecture demands strong strategies for performance monitoring and error management.
literalMeaning: Requires architecture based on services miniaturized strategies strong for monitoring of performance and management of errors.

arabic: يُتِيحُ اسْتِخْدَامُ وَاجِهَاتِ بَرْمَجَةِ التَّطْبِيقَاتِ تَكَامُلًا سَلِسًا بَيْنَ الأَنْظِمَةِ غَيْرِ المُتَجَانِسَةِ.
english: The use of application programming interfaces enables seamless integration between heterogeneous systems.
acceptedAlternatives: Using APIs enables seamless integration among heterogeneous systems.
The use of APIs enables seamless integration between disparate systems.
Using application programming interfaces allows seamless integration between heterogeneous systems.
literalMeaning: Allows use of interfaces programming of applications integration smooth between systems non-homogeneous.

arabic: تَسْتَخْدِمُ خَوَارِزْمِيَّاتُ التَّوَافُقِ فِي سَلَاسِلِ الكُتَلِ آَلِيَّاتِ إِثْبَاتِ الحِصَّةِ لِتَقْلِيلِ اسْتِهْلَاكِ الطَّاقَةِ.
english: Consensus algorithms in blockchains use proof-of-stake mechanisms to reduce energy consumption.
acceptedAlternatives: Consensus algorithms in blockchain use proof of stake mechanisms to cut energy consumption.
Blockchain consensus algorithms utilize proof-of-stake mechanisms to minimize energy consumption.
literalMeaning: Use algorithms of consensus in chains of blocks mechanisms proof of share to reduce consumption of energy.

arabic: تَأَكَّدْ مِنْ أَخْذِ نُسْخَةٍ احْتِيَاطِيَّةٍ لِمَلَفَّاتِكَ قَبْلَ بَدْءِ التَّرْقِيَةِ.
english: Make sure to back up your files before starting the upgrade.
acceptedAlternatives: Make sure to make a backup of your files before starting the upgrade.
Ensure you back up your files before beginning the upgrade.
Make sure you take a backup of your files before starting the upgrade.
literalMeaning: Make sure from taking copy backup for your files before start of the upgrade.

arabic: يَسْمَحُ لَنَا مُسْتَوْدَعُ الشِّفْرَةِ المَصْدَرِيَّةِ بِتَتَبُّعِ التَّغْيِيرَاتِ وَالتَّعَاوُنِ بِفَعَّالِيَّةٍ.
english: The source code repository allows us to track changes and collaborate effectively.
acceptedAlternatives: The source code repository lets us track changes and collaborate effectively.
The source code repo allows us to trace changes and collaborate effectively.
literalMeaning: Allows to us repository of code source with tracking changes and collaboration with effectiveness.

arabic: الصَّبْرُ مِفْتَاحُ الفَرَجِ.
english: Patience is the key to relief.
acceptedAlternatives: Patience is the key to ease.
Patience is key to relief.
literalMeaning: The patience key of the relief.

arabic: رِحْلَةُ الأَلْفِ مِيلٍ تَبْدَأُ بِخُطْوَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ.
english: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
acceptedAlternatives: The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
A journey of a thousand miles starts with one step.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with one step.
literalMeaning: Journey of the thousand miles begins with step one.

arabic: العِلْمُ فِي الصِّغَرِ كَالنَّقْشِ عَلَى الحَجَرِ.
english: Learning in youth is like engraving on stone.
acceptedAlternatives: Knowledge in childhood is like carving on stone.
Learning at a young age is like engraving on stone.
Learning in youth is like carving in stone.
literalMeaning: The knowledge in the youth like the engraving on the stone.

arabic: لَا تَحْكُمْ عَلَى الكِتَابِ مِنْ غِلَافِهِ فَالجَوْهَرُ يَكْمُنُ فِي الدَّاخِلِ.
english: Do not judge a book by its cover, for the essence lies within.
acceptedAlternatives: Don't judge a book by its cover, for the essence lies within.
Don't judge a book by its cover; the essence lies within.
Do not judge a book by its cover, as the true essence lies inside.
literalMeaning: Do not judge on the book from its cover, for the jewel lies in the inside.

arabic: مَنْ لَمْ يُجَرِّبْ طَعْمَ الفَشَلِ لَنْ يَتَذَوَّقَ حَلَاوَةَ النَّجَاحِ.
english: He who has not tasted failure will never appreciate the sweetness of success.
acceptedAlternatives: Whoever has not tasted failure will not taste the sweetness of success.
Those who have not tasted failure will never taste the sweetness of success.
He who has not experienced failure will not relish the sweetness of success.
literalMeaning: Who did not try taste of the failure will not taste sweetness of the success.

arabic: الوَقْتُ كَالسَّيْفِ إِنْ لَمْ تَقْطَعْهُ قَطَعَكَ.
english: Time is like a sword; if you do not cut it, it will cut you.
acceptedAlternatives: Time is like a sword; if you don't cut it, it cuts you.
Time is like a sword: if you do not cut it, it will sever you.
Time is like a sword, if you don't cut it, it will cut you.
literalMeaning: The time like the sword if you do not cut it, it cuts you.

arabic: الصَّدِيقُ وَقْتَ الضِّيقِ هُوَ الكَنْزُ الحَقِيقِيُّ فِي الحَيَاةِ.
english: A friend in need is a true treasure in life.
acceptedAlternatives: A friend in times of distress is the true treasure in life.
A true friend in times of trouble is life's real treasure.
literalMeaning: The friend time of hardship is the treasure real in the life.

arabic: لَيْسَتِ القُوَّةُ فِي التَّغَلُّبِ عَلَى الآخَرِينَ، بَلْ فِي السَّيْطَرَةِ عَلَى النَّفْسِ عِنْدَ الغَضَبِ.
english: Strength is not in conquering others, but in mastering oneself during anger.
acceptedAlternatives: Real strength lies not in defeating others, but in controlling oneself when angry.
True strength is not in overcoming others, but in self-control during anger.
Strength is not in overcoming others, but in mastering oneself when angry.
literalMeaning: Not the strength in overcoming on others, but in controlling on the self at anger.

arabic: الحِكْمَةُ ضَالَّةُ المُؤْمِنِ، أَنَّى وَجَدَهَا فَهُوَ أَحَقُّ النَّاسِ بِهَا.
english: Wisdom is the lost property of the believer; wherever he finds it, he is most entitled to it.
acceptedAlternatives: Wisdom is the believer's lost property; wherever they find it, they have the greatest right to it.
Wisdom is the lost treasure of the seeker; wherever found, they are most deserving of it.
literalMeaning: The wisdom lost-stray of the believer, wherever he found it, so he most rightful of people with it.

arabic: إِنَّ الشَّجَاعَةَ لَيْسَتْ غِيَابَ الخَوْفِ، بَلْ هِيَ القُدْرَةُ عَلَى التَّصَرُّفِ رَغْمَ وُجُودِهِ.
english: Courage is not the absence of fear, but the ability to act despite its presence.
acceptedAlternatives: Courage isn't the absence of fear, but the capacity to act despite it.
Courage is not the lack of fear, but rather the ability to act despite its existence.
literalMeaning: Indeed the courage not absence of fear, but it is the ability on behaving despite existence of it.

arabic: تَجْرِي الرِّيَاحُ بِمَا لَا تَشْتَهِي السُّفُنُ، لَكِنَّ البَحَّارَ المَاهِرَ يَتَكَيَّفُ مَعَ الأَمْوَاجِ.
english: Winds blow contrary to what ships desire, yet the skilled sailor adapts to the waves.
acceptedAlternatives: The winds blow as ships do not desire, but the skilled sailor adapts to the waves.
Winds do not blow as ships desire, yet the skilled sailor adapts to the waves.
literalMeaning: Run the winds with what not desire the ships, but the sailor skilled adapts with the waves.

arabic: مَنْ جَدَّ وَجَدَ، وَمَنْ زَرَعَ حَصَدَ.
english: Whoever strives shall find, and whoever sows shall reap.
acceptedAlternatives: He who strives finds, and he who sows reaps.
Whoever works hard finds success, and whoever sows reaps.
Those who strive succeed, and those who sow reap.
literalMeaning: Who strived found, and who sowed harvested.

arabic: سَنَعْقِدُ اجْتِمَاعًا صَبَاحَ الغَدِ لِمُنَاقَشَةِ خِطَّةِ المَشْرُوعِ.
english: We will hold a meeting tomorrow morning to discuss the project plan.
acceptedAlternatives: We'll hold a meeting tomorrow morning to discuss the project plan.
We will have a meeting tomorrow morning to discuss the project plan.
We'll have a meeting tomorrow morning to discuss the project plan.
literalMeaning: We will hold a meeting morning of tomorrow to discuss plan of the project.

arabic: يُرْجَى إِرْسَالُ التَّقْرِيرِ المَالِيِّ قَبْلَ نِهَايَةِ يَوْمِ العَمَلِ.
english: Please send the financial report before the end of the business day.
acceptedAlternatives: Please send the financial report before the end of the workday.
Kindly send the financial report before the close of business.
Please submit the financial report before the end of the day.
literalMeaning: Please sending the report financial before end of day of the work.

arabic: نَحْنُ نَهْدِفُ إِلَى زِيَادَةِ المَبِيعَاتِ بِنِسْبَةِ عَشَرَةٍ فِي المِائَةِ هَذَا الرُّبْعَ.
english: We aim to increase sales by ten percent this quarter.
acceptedAlternatives: We aim to increase sales by 10% this quarter.
Our goal is to increase sales by ten percent this quarter.
We are aiming to raise sales by ten percent this quarter.
literalMeaning: We aim to increase sales by percentage ten in the hundred this quarter.

arabic: تَتَطَلَّبُ المُفَاوَضَاتُ النَّاجِحَةُ فَهْمًا دَقِيقًا لِاحْتِيَاجَاتِ الطَّرَفِ الآخَرِ.
english: Successful negotiations require a precise understanding of the other party's needs.
acceptedAlternatives: Successful negotiations require an accurate understanding of the other party's needs.
Successful bargaining requires a deep understanding of the other side's needs.
literalMeaning: Requires negotiations successful understanding precise to needs of party the other.

arabic: يَجِبُ أَنْ نَلْتَزِمَ بِالمَوْعِدِ النِّهَائِيِّ لِتَسْلِيمِ المُنْتَجِ لِلعَمِيلِ.
english: We must adhere to the deadline for delivering the product to the client.
acceptedAlternatives: We must meet the deadline to deliver the product to the customer.
We have to adhere to the deadline for delivering the product to the client.
We should stick to the deadline for delivering the product to the client.
literalMeaning: Must that we commit with the time final to delivery of the product to the client.

arabic: يُعْتَبَرُ رِضَا العُمَلَاءِ المِعْيَارَ الرَّئِيسِيَّ لِقِيَاسِ نَجَاحِ حَمْلَتِنَا التَّسْوِيقِيَّةِ.
english: Customer satisfaction is considered the main metric for measuring the success of our marketing campaign.
acceptedAlternatives: Customer satisfaction is the main criterion for measuring our marketing campaign's success.
Client satisfaction is considered the primary benchmark for measuring the success of our marketing campaign.
literalMeaning: Is considered satisfaction of customers the metric main to measuring success of campaign our marketing.

arabic: سَنَقُومُ بِمُرَاجَعَةِ المِيزَانِيَّةِ التَّقْدِيرِيَّةِ مَعَ مُدِيرِ الحِسَابَاتِ غَدًا.
english: We will review the estimated budget with the account manager tomorrow.
acceptedAlternatives: We'll review the estimated budget with the account manager tomorrow.
We will review the projected budget with the accounting manager tomorrow.
We'll review the budget estimate with the account manager tomorrow.
literalMeaning: We will do with reviewing budget estimated with manager of accounts tomorrow.

arabic: يَتَطَلَّبُ التَّوَسُّعُ فِي الأَسْوَاقِ الإِقْلِيمِيَّةِ إِجْرَاءَ دِرَاسَةِ جَدْوَى شَامِلَةٍ وَتَحْلِيلِ المَخَاطِرِ.
english: Expanding into regional markets requires conducting a comprehensive feasibility study and risk analysis.
acceptedAlternatives: Expansion into regional markets requires a comprehensive feasibility study and risk assessment.
Expanding into regional markets requires conducting a thorough feasibility study and risk analysis.
literalMeaning: Requires expansion in markets regional conducting study of feasibility comprehensive and analysis of risks.

arabic: تَسْعَى الشَّرِكَةُ إِلَى تَنْوِيعِ مَصَادِرِ إِيرَادَاتِهَا لِضَمَانِ الِاسْتِدَامَةِ المَالِيَّةِ عَلَى المَدَى الطَّوِيلِ.
english: The company seeks to diversify its revenue streams to ensure long-term financial sustainability.
acceptedAlternatives: The company is seeking to diversify its revenue sources to guarantee long-term financial sustainability.
The company aims to diversify its revenue streams to ensure long-term financial sustainability.
literalMeaning: Strives the company to diversification sources of revenues its to ensure sustainability financial on term long.

arabic: تَمَّ التَّوَقِيعُ عَلَى اتِّفَاقِيَّةِ الشَّرَاكَةِ الِاسْتِرَاتِيجِيَّةِ بَعْدَ مُفَاوَضَاتٍ مُكَثَّفَةٍ دَامَتْ عِدَّةَ أَشْهُرٍ.
english: The strategic partnership agreement was signed after intensive negotiations lasting several months.
acceptedAlternatives: The strategic partnership agreement was signed after intensive negotiations that lasted several months.
The strategic partnership agreement was signed following months of intensive negotiations.
literalMeaning: Completed signing on agreement of partnership strategic after negotiations intensive lasted several months.

arabic: يَسْتَهْدِفُ رَأْسُ المَالِ الجَرِيءُ دَعْمَ المَشَارِيعِ الِابْتِكَارِيَّةِ ذَاتِ الفُرَصِ النَّمَائِيَّةِ العَالِيَةِ.
english: Venture capital aims to support innovative ventures with high growth potential.
acceptedAlternatives: Venture capital targets supporting innovative projects with high growth potential.
Venture capital aims to back innovative startups with high growth potential.
literalMeaning: Targets capital daring supporting projects innovative with opportunities developmental high.

arabic: يَنْبَغِي تَوْزِيعُ المَهَامِّ عَلَى أَعْضَاءِ الفَرِيقِ بِنَاءً عَلَى خِبْرَاتِهِمْ وَكِفَايَاتِهِمْ المِهْنِيَّةِ.
english: Tasks should be distributed among team members based on their expertise and professional competencies.
acceptedAlternatives: Tasks should be delegated to team members based on their expertise and professional skills.
Tasks ought to be distributed among team members based on their experience and professional competencies.
literalMeaning: Ought distribution of tasks on members of the team building on their experiences and competencies professional.
